== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Legacy [[You Will Take Me To Jabba Now (V)]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column. Same-words image changes are not columns: [[You Will Take Me To Jabba Now (V) (Errata 3)]] shares the [[You Will Take Me To Jabba Now (V) (Errata 2)]] column.
